LatePoint Alternative for WordPress

Looking for a LatePoint alternative? If you have more than one person taking bookings, Roohsites Appointment Booking's free version has unlimited staff, and Roohsites Appointment Booking Pro adds payments, reminders and Google Calendar for $79 a year.

Checked on October 31, 2026 from each plugin's WordPress.org page and pricing page. Prices are regular (not sale) prices in US dollars. These plugins run sales often and change their plans, so check their sites before you buy.

LatePoint's free version

LatePoint's free version is generous with payments: it takes Stripe, PayPal and Razorpay, and includes events. On its WordPress.org page, multiple staff, rescheduling, refunds, service extras, SMS and WhatsApp notifications, reminders and Google Calendar sync are listed as LatePoint Pro features.

Roohsites Appointment Booking's free version has no staff or service limit, so a salon with five stylists or a tutoring centre with twenty classes can take bookings without paying. Online payments, reminders and calendar sync are in Roohsites Appointment Booking Pro.

LatePoint pricing vs Roohsites Appointment Booking

LatePoint: $99 a year for 1 site, $249 for 5 sites, $499 for up to 100 sites. Sale prices apply to the first year, then renew at the regular price (their pricing page).

Roohsites Appointment Booking Pro: $79 a year for 1 site, $149 for 5 sites, $299 for unlimited. Same price every year: what you pay in year one is what you pay in year two.

Three years, one website (regular prices): Roohsites Appointment Booking Pro $237 (1 site); LatePoint $297 (1 site, yearly).

When LatePoint is the better choice

LatePoint has a clean, modern booking form, takes payments in its free version and includes events. It says it is used on 100,000+ WordPress sites.

  • You work alone and want free payments. LatePoint's free version takes Stripe, PayPal and Razorpay. Roohsites Appointment Booking's online payments are part of Pro.
  • You need online meetings. LatePoint Pro lists Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams. Roohsites Appointment Booking doesn't create meeting links yet.
  • You need recurring or group bookings. Both are LatePoint Pro features. Roohsites Appointment Booking books one person into one time slot.

Why people choose Roohsites Appointment Booking instead

  • Unlimited staff for free. LatePoint's free version has one staff member; multiple staff is a LatePoint Pro feature.
  • Customers reschedule themselves from Roohsites Appointment Booking Pro's My bookings page; rescheduling is a LatePoint Pro feature too.
  • $20 less per year for one site: Roohsites Appointment Booking Pro is $79 and LatePoint is $99 at its regular price, and Roohsites Appointment Booking renews at the same price.
  • Automatic refunds when you cancel a paid booking, through Razorpay, Stripe or PayPal.
  • WhatsApp and SMS reminders and Google Calendar sync are in Roohsites Appointment Booking Pro, with no add-ons.

What you get with Roohsites Appointment Booking

  • Free, with unlimited staff and services: a three-step booking form (Booking form block or [rsab_booking] shortcode), a calendar that only shows free times, email confirmations, a secure cancel link for customers, approval or auto-confirm, and WordPress's privacy tools for customer data requests.
  • Roohsites Appointment Booking Pro: online payments or deposits with Razorpay (UPI, cards, netbanking, wallets), Stripe or PayPal, confirmed instantly by webhook and refunded automatically when you cancel; reminders by email, SMS or WhatsApp; two-way Google Calendar sync for each staff member; a drag-and-drop admin calendar; a "My bookings" page where customers reschedule or cancel without an account; breaks and special dates; service extras, coupons, extra questions and branded emails.
  • Pricing: $79 a year for one site, $149 for five and $299 for unlimited. Renewals cost the same as your first year. 14-day free trial (no card) and a 14-day money-back guarantee. If you stop renewing, Pro keeps working; only updates and support stop.

How to switch from LatePoint to Roohsites Appointment Booking

  1. Install the free Roohsites Appointment Booking plugin next to LatePoint. They don't interfere with each other.
  2. Add your services (name, duration, price, buffer) and staff (photo, services, weekly hours, days off) under Roohsites Appointment Booking. Roohsites Appointment Booking doesn't import LatePoint data, so this is done by hand; for most small businesses it takes 10 to 20 minutes.
  3. On your booking page, replace the LatePoint form with the Booking form block, or the [rsab_booking] shortcode in a page builder.
  4. Keep LatePoint active until its last upcoming bookings have passed, then deactivate it.
  5. Need payments, reminders or Google Calendar? Start the 14-day Pro trial and connect Razorpay, Stripe or PayPal under Roohsites Appointment Booking → Pro settings.

Frequently asked questions

What is a good alternative to LatePoint for a team?

Roohsites Appointment Booking: its free version has unlimited staff, while LatePoint's free version has one staff member. Roohsites Appointment Booking Pro adds payments, reminders and Google Calendar for $79 a year.

Is LatePoint free?

LatePoint has a free version with Stripe, PayPal and Razorpay payments and events. Multiple staff, reminders, rescheduling and Google Calendar sync are LatePoint Pro features, from $99 a year for one site.

Is Roohsites Appointment Booking cheaper than LatePoint?

For one site, Roohsites Appointment Booking Pro is $79 a year and LatePoint is $99 a year at regular prices. Over three years that's $237 and $297.

Can I switch from LatePoint to Roohsites Appointment Booking?

Yes. Roohsites Appointment Booking doesn't import LatePoint data, so set up your services and staff, swap the form on your booking page, and keep LatePoint active until its upcoming bookings have passed.
